units.en: As the saying goes: "Fine words can be traded in the marketplace; noble conduct can raise a man above his station.
units.literal: The tradition says: "Fine words can command a price; noble conduct can elevate a man above others.

units.zh: 君子相送以言，小人相送以財。」
units.en: The gentleman sends a friend on his way with words; the petty man sends him off with gold."
units.literal: The gentleman sees others off with words; the petty man sees others off with gifts."

units.zh: 魏文侯時，西門豹為鄴令。
units.en: In the time of Marquis Wen of Wei, Ximen Bao was appointed magistrate of the city of Ye.
units.literal: During the time of Marquis Wen of Wei, Ximen Bao served as the magistrate of Ye.

units.zh: 豹往到鄴，會長老，問之民所疾苦。
units.en: When Bao arrived in Ye, he gathered the elders together and asked them what afflictions the people suffered.
units.literal: When Bao arrived in Ye, he assembled the elders and asked them about the people's afflictions and sufferings.

units.zh: 長老曰：「苦為河伯娶婦，以故貧。」
units.en: The elders said: "Our great affliction is the yearly marriage to the River God. It has bled us into poverty."
units.literal: The elders said: "We suffer from having to provide a bride for the River God, and because of this we are impoverished."

units.zh: 豹問其故，對曰：「鄴三老、廷掾常歲賦斂百姓，收取其錢得數百萬，用其二三十萬為河伯娶婦，與祝巫共分其餘錢持歸。
units.en: Bao asked them to explain. They replied: "Every year the three elders and district clerks of Ye levy a tax on the common people, collecting several million coins. They spend two or three hundred thousand on a bride for the River God, and the shamans and prayer-masters pocket the rest.
units.literal: Bao asked for the details. They replied: "The three elders and the court clerks of Ye levy a tax upon the people every year, collecting several million coins. They spend two or three hundred thousand to find a bride for the River God, and the shamans and prayer-masters divide the remaining money among themselves and take it home.

units.zh: 當其時，巫行視小家女好者，云是當為河伯婦，即娉取。
units.en: When the season arrives, the shamans go from house to house, inspecting the daughters of humble families for beauty. They declare one of them to be the chosen bride of the River God and take her with a betrothal payment.
units.literal: When the time comes, the shamans go around inspecting the pretty girls of humble families, declaring that one is to become the River God's bride, and take her with a betrothal gift.

units.zh: 洗沐之，為治新繒綺縠衣，閒居齋戒；
units.en: They bathe her, dress her in new garments of silk and gauze, and set her apart in seclusion to fast and purify herself.
units.literal: They bathe and groom her, dress her in new garments of silk and fine gauze, and keep her in seclusion to fast and purify herself;

units.zh: 為治齋宮河上，張緹絳帷，女居其中。
units.en: They erect a purification lodge on the riverbank, hung with curtains of orange and crimson, and the girl takes up residence inside.
units.literal: They build a purification lodge by the river, hang curtains of orange and crimson silk, and the girl dwells within.

units.zh: 為具牛酒飯食，行十餘日。
units.en: They lay out offerings of beef, wine, and food, and the ceremonies continue for more than ten days.
units.literal: They prepare oxen, wine, and food, and this goes on for more than ten days.

units.zh: 共粉飾之，如嫁女床席，令女居其上，浮之河中。
units.en: They paint and adorn her, arrange a bed and mat as though for a bride being given away, seat the girl upon it, and set the whole thing floating on the river.
units.literal: Together they adorn her with powder and cosmetics, prepare a bed and mat as though for a bride being married off, have the girl sit upon it, and set it afloat on the river.

units.zh: 始浮，行數十里乃沒。
units.en: For a time the raft floats, drifting dozens of li downstream before sinking beneath the water.
units.literal: At first it floats, drifting several dozen li before sinking.

units.zh: 其人家有好女者，恐大巫祝為河伯取之，以故多持女遠逃亡。
units.en: Any family with a beautiful daughter lives in terror that the head shaman will choose her for the River God. And so most of them take their daughters and flee to distant places.
units.literal: Families with beautiful daughters fear that the head shaman will select their girl for the River God, and so most of them take their daughters and flee far away.

units.zh: 以故城中益空無人，又困貧，所從來久遠矣。
units.en: Because of this, the city has grown emptier and emptier, and those who remain are mired in poverty. This has been going on for a very long time.
units.literal: Because of this, the city grows ever emptier and more desolate, and the people are trapped in poverty. This has been going on for a very long time.

units.zh: 民人俗語曰『即不為河伯娶婦，水來漂沒，溺其人民』云。」
units.en: The common folk say: 'If we do not give the River God his bride, the waters will come and drown us all.'"
units.literal: The common folk have a saying: 'If we do not provide a bride for the River God, the waters will come and flood, drowning the people.'"

units.zh: 西門豹曰：「至為河伯娶婦時，願三老、巫祝、父老送女河上，幸來告語之，吾亦往送女。」
units.en: Ximen Bao said: "When the time comes for the River God's wedding, I would like the three elders, the shamans, and the village elders to escort the bride to the riverbank. Be sure to let me know — I wish to attend the ceremony and see her off myself."
units.literal: Ximen Bao said: "When the time comes to marry the bride to the River God, I hope the three elders, the shamans, and the village elders will escort the girl to the river. Please come and let me know, as I too wish to go and see the bride off."

units.zh: 皆曰：「諾。」
units.en: They all said, "Yes."
units.literal: They all said: "Yes, we will."

units.zh: 至其時，西門豹往會之河上。
units.en: When the appointed day arrived, Ximen Bao went to the riverbank to join the assembly.
units.literal: When the time came, Ximen Bao went to the gathering at the river.

units.zh: 三老、官屬、豪長者、裏父老皆會，以人民往觀之者三二千人。
units.en: The three elders, the officials, the local magnates, and the village elders were all assembled, and two or three thousand common people had come to watch.
units.literal: The three elders, the officials and their subordinates, the local magnates and village elders all gathered, and two or three thousand common people came to watch.

units.zh: 其巫，老女子也，已年七十。
units.en: The head shaman was an old woman of seventy.
units.literal: The head shaman was an old woman, already seventy years of age.

units.zh: 從弟子女十人所，皆衣繒單衣，立大巫后。
units.en: Behind her stood some ten female disciples, all dressed in robes of silk.
units.literal: She was followed by about ten female disciples, all dressed in silk robes, standing behind the head shaman.

units.zh: 西門豹曰：「呼河伯婦來，視其好醜。」
units.en: Ximen Bao said: "Bring out the bride for the River God. Let me take a look at whether she is beautiful enough."
units.literal: Ximen Bao said: "Bring the River God's bride here so I may see whether she is beautiful or ugly."

units.zh: 即將女出帷中，來至前。
units.en: They led the girl out from behind the curtains and brought her before him.
units.literal: They immediately brought the girl out from behind the curtains and led her forward.

units.zh: 豹視之，顧謂三老、巫祝、父老曰：「是女子不好，煩大巫嫗為入報河伯，得更求好女，后日送之。」
units.en: Bao studied the girl, then turned to the three elders, the shamans, and the village elders: "This girl will not do — she is not beautiful enough. I must trouble the old shaman woman to go into the river and inform the River God that we need more time to find a prettier girl. We will send her along on another day."
units.literal: Bao looked at her, then turned to the three elders, the shamans, and the village elders and said: "This girl is not beautiful enough. I must trouble the head shaman to go into the river and report to the River God that we will find a more beautiful girl and send her on a later day."

units.zh: 即使吏卒共抱大巫嫗投之河中。
units.en: At once, he ordered his officers and soldiers to seize the old shaman woman and hurl her into the river.
units.literal: He immediately ordered his officers and soldiers to seize the head shaman and throw her into the river.

units.zh: 有頃，曰：「巫嫗何久也？
units.en: After a short while, he said: "What is taking the old shaman so long?
units.literal: After a short while, he said: "Why is the shaman taking so long?

units.zh: 弟子趣之！」
units.en: Send one of her disciples to hurry her along!"
units.literal: Send a disciple to hurry her along!"

units.zh: 復以弟子一人投河中。
units.en: And so one of the disciples was thrown into the river.
units.literal: They threw another disciple into the river.

units.zh: 有頃，曰：「弟子何久也？
units.en: After a further while, he said: "What is taking the disciple so long?
units.literal: After another while, he said: "Why is the disciple taking so long?

units.zh: 復使一人趣之！」
units.en: Send another to fetch her!"
units.literal: Send another to hurry her along!"

units.zh: 復投一弟子河中。
units.en: Another disciple was hurled into the river.
units.literal: Another disciple was thrown into the river.

units.zh: 凡投三弟子。
units.en: In total, three disciples were cast in.
units.literal: In all, three disciples were thrown in.

units.zh: 西門豹曰：「巫嫗弟子是女子也，不能白事，煩三老為入白之。」
units.en: Ximen Bao said: "These disciples are mere girls — they cannot deliver the message properly. I must trouble the three elders to go in and speak to the River God themselves."
units.literal: Ximen Bao said: "The shaman's disciples are mere girls and cannot properly deliver a message. I must trouble the three elders to go in and report on our behalf."

units.zh: 復投三老河中。
units.en: And the three elders were thrown into the river.
units.literal: The three elders were thrown into the river.

units.zh: 西門豹簪筆磬折，向河立待良久。
units.en: Ximen Bao, his writing brush tucked in his cap, bowed low toward the river and stood waiting for a very long time.
units.literal: Ximen Bao, with his writing brush tucked in his cap, bowed deeply and stood facing the river, waiting for a long time.

units.zh: 長老、吏傍觀者皆驚恐。
units.en: The elders, the officials, and all the onlookers were seized with terror.
units.literal: The elders, officials, and bystanders were all terrified.

units.zh: 西門豹顧曰：「巫嫗、三老不來還，柰之何？」
units.en: Ximen Bao turned around: "The old shaman and the three elders have not returned. What shall we do about that?"
units.literal: Ximen Bao turned and said: "The shaman woman and the three elders have not come back. What shall we do?"

units.zh: 欲復使廷掾與豪長者一人入趣之。
units.en: He made as if to send the district clerk and one of the local magnates into the river to fetch them.
units.literal: He proposed to send the district clerk and one of the local magnates into the river to hurry them along.

units.zh: 皆叩頭，叩頭且破，額血流地，色如死灰。
units.en: Every one of them flung himself to the ground, smashing his forehead against the earth until the skin split and blood ran down onto the ground. Their faces turned the color of ash.
units.literal: They all kowtowed frantically, kowtowing until their foreheads nearly split open, blood flowing from their brows onto the ground, their faces the color of dead ash.

units.zh: 西門豹曰：「諾，且留待之須臾。」
units.en: Ximen Bao said: "Very well. Let us wait a moment longer."
units.literal: Ximen Bao said: "Very well, let us stay and wait for them a little longer."

units.zh: 須臾，豹曰：「廷掾起矣。
units.en: After a pause, Bao said: "The district clerk may rise.
units.literal: After a moment, Bao said: "The district clerk may rise.

units.zh: 狀河伯留客之久，若皆罷去歸矣。」
units.en: It seems the River God is keeping his guests rather a long time. You may all disperse and go home."
units.literal: It seems the River God is keeping his guests for a long time. You may all disperse and go home."

units.zh: 鄴吏民大驚恐，從是以後，不敢復言為河伯娶婦。
units.en: The officials and people of Ye were struck with terror. From that day forward, no one ever dared mention the River God's bride again.
units.literal: The officials and people of Ye were greatly terrified, and from that time on no one dared speak again of providing a bride for the River God.

units.zh: 西門豹即發民鑿十二渠，引河水灌民田，田皆溉。
units.en: Ximen Bao then set the people to work digging twelve irrigation canals, channeling the river's water to irrigate their fields. Every field in the district was watered.
units.literal: Ximen Bao then mobilized the people to dig twelve irrigation canals, diverting river water to irrigate the people's fields, and all the fields were watered.

units.zh: 當其時，民治渠少煩苦，不欲也。
units.en: At the time, the people found the labor of digging the canals burdensome and resented it.
units.literal: At that time, the people found the work of building the canals somewhat burdensome and painful, and they were not willing.

units.zh: 豹曰：「民可以樂成，不可與慮始。
units.en: Bao said: "The common people can take pleasure in what is completed, but they cannot be asked to deliberate on what is begun.
units.literal: Bao said: "The people can enjoy the result, but they cannot be consulted about the beginning.

units.zh: 今父老子弟雖患苦我，然百歲後期令父老子孫思我言。」
units.en: Though the elders and their sons may curse me today, a hundred years hence I trust their descendants will remember what I have said."
units.literal: Though the elders and their sons may resent me now, in a hundred years I expect their descendants will remember my words."

units.zh: 至今皆得水利，民人以給足富。
units.en: To this day, the people enjoy the benefits of irrigation, and the district has become prosperous and self-sufficient.
units.literal: To this day they all benefit from the irrigation, and the people have become prosperous and well-supplied.

units.zh: 十二渠經絕馳道，到漢之立，而長吏以為十二渠橋絕馳道，相比近，不可。
units.en: The twelve canals crossed the imperial highway. After the founding of the Han dynasty, senior officials complained that the twelve canal bridges cutting across the highway were set too close together and demanded they be altered.
units.literal: The twelve canals crossed and cut through the imperial highway. When the Han dynasty was established, senior officials objected that the twelve canal bridges crossing the highway were too close together, and that this was unacceptable.

units.zh: 欲合渠水，且至馳道合三渠為一橋。
units.en: They proposed to consolidate the waterways, merging every three canals into a single bridge where they crossed the highway.
units.literal: They wished to consolidate the canal water, combining three canals into one bridge where they reached the highway.

units.zh: 鄴民人父老不肯聽長吏，以為西門君所為也，賢君之法式不可更也。
units.en: But the people and elders of Ye refused to comply. These were Lord Ximen's works, they said, and the designs of a worthy lord must not be altered.
units.literal: The people and elders of Ye refused to listen to the senior officials, insisting that this was Lord Ximen's work, and that the regulations established by a worthy lord must not be changed.

units.zh: 長吏終聽置之。
units.en: In the end, the officials relented and left the canals as they were.
units.literal: In the end the senior officials relented and left them as they were.

units.zh: 故西門豹為鄴令，名聞天下，澤流後世，無絕已時，幾可謂非賢大夫哉！
units.en: And so Ximen Bao governed Ye, and his name became known throughout the realm. His blessings have flowed down to later generations without end. Could anyone deny that he was a worthy minister?
units.literal: Thus, Ximen Bao served as magistrate of Ye, his fame spread throughout the realm, and his beneficence flowed down to later generations without cease. How could one say he was not a worthy minister!

units.zh: 傳曰：「子產治鄭，民不能欺；
units.en: There is a saying: "When Zichan governed Zheng, the people could not deceive him;
units.literal: A tradition states: "When Zichan governed Zheng, the people were unable to deceive him;

units.zh: 子賤治單父，民不忍欺；
units.en: When Zijian governed Shanfu, the people could not bring themselves to deceive him;
units.literal: when Zijian governed Shanfu, the people could not bear to deceive him;

units.zh: 西門豹治鄴，民不敢欺。」
units.en: When Ximen Bao governed Ye, the people dared not deceive him."
units.literal: when Ximen Bao governed Ye, the people dared not deceive him."

units.zh: 三子之才能誰最賢哉？
units.en: Of these three men, whose ability was the greatest?
units.literal: Among the abilities of these three men, who was the most worthy?

units.zh: 辨治者當能別之。
units.en: Those who truly understand the art of governance should be able to tell the difference.
units.literal: Those who understand governance should be able to distinguish between them.
